name: Lameness
overview: Scripture addresses lameness both literally and figuratively, highlighting its significance in spiritual and physical contexts. Lameness disqualified priests from serving in the sanctuary (Leviticus 21:18) and rendered animals unsuitable for sacrifice (Deuteronomy 15:21), underscoring the call for holiness and perfection in worship. Yet, the gospel powerfully demonstrates healing through Jesus and Peter, restoring the lame to walk and glorifying God (Matthew 11:5; Matthew 15:31; Matthew 21:14; Luke 7:22). This healing points beyond physical restoration to the spiritual renewal Christ offers, transforming those once disqualified into members of His holy family.
